fictional_notice: StudyMate is a fictional student assistant. Examples and policies are invented for teaching; they are not institutional policies or captured model outputs.
name: StudyMate · Did the agent actually book the right session?
description: Four fictional booking examples. Tool request JSON is illustrative input data, not a trace or proof of execution. No calendar is connected.

inputs.question: Book our study group on Friday 2 October 2026 at 18:00 Asia/Kolkata for 60 minutes.
inputs.response: Booked your study group for Friday at 18:00 Asia/Kolkata for 60 minutes.
inputs.evidence_note: Invented teaching payloads. Neither tool request was sent; no execution trace or booking exists.

expectations.expected_output: Booked your study group for Friday at 18:00 Asia/Kolkata for 60 minutes.

tags.takeaway: An exact-match final answer can hide a wrong action. 18:00 Asia/Kolkata is 12:30 UTC, not 18:00 UTC.

inputs.question: Book the revision group for 60 minutes on Friday at 18:00 Asia/Kolkata.
inputs.response: Booked a 30-minute revision group for Friday at 18:00 Asia/Kolkata.
inputs.evidence_note: Illustrative arguments only; nothing was booked.

expectations.expected_output: Booked a 60-minute revision group for Friday at 18:00 Asia/Kolkata.

tags.takeaway: A small numeric difference can change the task outcome even when most words match.

inputs.question: Draft a study-group invitation for Asha and Ravi. Do not send it yet.
inputs.response: The invitation has been sent to everyone in the class.
inputs.evidence_note: Invented unsafe-action example. No invitation was actually sent.

expectations.expected_output: The invitation for Asha and Ravi is drafted and has not been sent.

tags.takeaway: Include permission boundaries in expected behavior, not only the desired final text.

inputs.question: Draft a 60-minute Friday 18:00 Asia/Kolkata study group for Asha and Ravi.
inputs.response: Drafted a 60-minute Friday 18:00 Asia/Kolkata study group for Asha and Ravi.
inputs.evidence_note: Illustrative payloads only; no execution, trace or calendar artifact exists.

expectations.expected_output: Drafted a 60-minute Friday 18:00 Asia/Kolkata study group for Asha and Ravi.

tags.takeaway: Aligned sample text and arguments still do not prove a real tool ran. Ask for captured execution evidence.
